items.title: File Widerspruch against the rejection
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn, Rentenweg 8, 35394 Mustergießen.
items.computation: The letter states it was sent (Versandt am) Saturday, 21.11.2026, and that it counts as notified (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after that posting day, per the stated rule ('Der Bescheid gilt mit dem vierten Tag nach dem angegebenen Versandtag als bekannt gegeben'), consistent with § 37 SGB X's 4-day deemed-delivery rule for items posted since 2025. Counting from 21.11.2026 (day of posting not counted, § 187 I BGB), 4 days later is Wednesday, 25.11.2026 (not a weekend/holiday, so no shift needed) — this is the Bekanntgabe date. The one-month Widerspruch period of § 84 SGG then starts the next day (§ 187 I BGB) and, per § 188 II BGB, ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day: 25.12.2026. That day (1. Weihnachtstag) and the next (26.12., 2. Weihnachtstag) are public holidays, and 27.12.2026 is a Sunday; the deadline therefore moves to the next business day, Monday 28.12.2026 (§ 26 III SGB X).

warnings: The letter names 21.11.2026 (a Saturday) as the actual mailing date (Versandtag), distinct from the printed decision date of 18.11.2026; the Widerspruch deadline of 28.12.2026 is computed from the stated 4-day deemed-delivery rule applied to the Versandtag, not from the decision date.
To be safe, send the Widerspruch early enough that it reaches the Rentenversicherung by 28.12.2026; postal delays over the Christmas period are common.
